title: Godot crashes with signal 4 when configuring GPUParticles3D
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and reproducible in 4.6.2.

### System information

Godot string: "Godot v4.6.2.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000 (IVB GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3320M CPU @ 2.60GHz (2 threads) - 7.57 GiB memory" Notes: Xlibre as an X server, System does not have a dGPU (DRI_PRIME value is one?)

### Steps to reproduce

Create a project using the Mobile or Forward+ renderer, then create a scene with a root GPUParticles3D. Configure it, and you should crash. Specifically, I create a QuadMesh as the first render pass, and when I try to add a material to it, Godot crashes.
This also occurs configuring it avoiding setting a material, but is delayed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None, follow steps above.
